evidence: Modifies startup configuration and argument parsing exception handling in node startup code (`src/node/caches.{cpp,h}`) and tests `settings.json` handling.
rationale: Fixes an unhandled `std::terminate` abort during startup when an invalid `dbcache` value is present in `settings.json`. Removing `noexcept` allows parse errors to propagate cleanly to `AppInit`'s error handler.
